stem:
Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

With which statement would both the author of the excerpt from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and the author of the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint” most likely agree?

options.label: A
options.text: People can save a great deal of money through co-living and co-working.

options.label: B
options.text: People can still feel isolated when co-living or co-working in shared spaces.

options.label: C
options.text: Co-living and co-working is an idea from the past on to which new groups have latched.

options.label: D
options.text: Co-living and co-working can be stressful in the wrong circumstances.
